## Un confounder binario {background-color="#23373B" .center}

## Simulación

```{r}
#| code-line-numbers: "|1|3|4-8|9"
#| output-location: slide
n <- 1000 
sim <- tibble(
  confounder = rbinom(n, 1, 0.5),
  p_exposure = case_when(
    confounder == 1 ~ 0.75,
    confounder == 0 ~ 0.25
  ),
  exposure = rbinom(n, 1, p_exposure),
  outcome = confounder + rnorm(n)
) |> select(-p_exposure)

sim
```

## Simulación

```{r}
#| code-line-numbers: "|2|3"
#| output-location: fragment
sim |>
  group_by(exposure) |>
  summarise(avg_y = mean(outcome))
```

## Simulación

```{r}
#| code-line-numbers: "|2"
#| output-location: fragment
sim |>
  group_by(exposure) |>
  summarise(avg_y = mean(outcome)) |>
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = exposure, 
    values_from = avg_y,  
    names_prefix = "x_"
  ) |>
  summarise(estimate = x_1 - x_0) 
```

## Dos confounders binarios {background-color="#23373B" .center}

## Simulación

```{r}
#| code-line-numbers: "|4-10,12"
#| output-location: slide
n <- 1000
sim2 <- tibble(
  confounder_1 = rbinom(n, 1, 0.5),
  confounder_2 = rbinom(n, 1, 0.5), 
  p_exposure = case_when(
    confounder_1 == 1 & confounder_2 == 1 ~ 0.75,
    confounder_1 == 0 & confounder_2 == 1 ~ 0.9,
    confounder_1 == 1 & confounder_2 == 0 ~ 0.2,
    confounder_1 == 0 & confounder_2 == 0 ~ 0.1,
  ),
  exposure = rbinom(n, 1, p_exposure),
  outcome = confounder_1 + confounder_2 + rnorm(n) 
) |> select(-p_exposure)

sim2
```

## Simulación

```{r}
lm(outcome ~ exposure, data = sim2)
```

## *Tu turno 2*

### Agrupa el dataset por los confounders y la exposición
### Calcula la media del resultado para los grupos

`r countdown::countdown(minutes = 2)`

## *Tu turno 2*

```{r}
#| code-line-numbers: "|2"
#| output-location: fragment
sim2 |>
  group_by(confounder_1, confounder_2, exposure) |>
  summarise(avg_y = mean(outcome)) |>
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = exposure,
    values_from = avg_y,  
    names_prefix = "x_"
  ) |>
  summarise(estimate = x_1 - x_0, .groups = "drop") |
  summarise(estimate = mean(estimate))
```

## Simulación

```{r}
#| code-line-numbers: "|1"
#| output-location: slide
n <- 100000
big_sim2 <- tibble(
  confounder_1 = rbinom(n, 1, 0.5),
  confounder_2 = rbinom(n, 1, 0.5), 
  p_exposure = case_when(
    confounder_1 == 1 & confounder_2 == 1 ~ 0.75,
    confounder_1 == 0 & confounder_2 == 1 ~ 0.9,
    confounder_1 == 1 & confounder_2 == 0 ~ 0.2,
    confounder_1 == 0 & confounder_2 == 0 ~ 0.1,
  ),
  exposure = rbinom(n, 1, p_exposure),
  outcome = confounder_1 + confounder_2 + rnorm(n) 
) |> select(-p_exposure)

big_sim2
```

## Simulación

```{r}
lm(outcome ~ exposure, data = big_sim2)
```

## Simulación

```{r}
#| code-line-numbers: "|2"
#| output-location: fragment
big_sim2 |>
  group_by(confounder_1, confounder_2, exposure) |>
  summarise(avg_y = mean(outcome)) |>
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = exposure,
    values_from = avg_y,  
    names_prefix = "x_"
  ) |>
  summarise(estimate = x_1 - x_0, .groups = "drop") |
  summarise(estimate = mean(estimate))  
```


## Confundor continuo? {background-color="#23373B" .center}

## Simulación

```{r}
#| code-line-numbers: "|3"
#| output-location: slide
n <- 10000 
sim3 <- tibble(
  confounder = rnorm(n), 
  p_exposure = exp(confounder) / (1 + exp(confounder)),
  exposure = rbinom(n, 1, p_exposure),
  outcome = confounder + rnorm(n) 
) |> select(-p_exposure)

sim3
```

## Simulación

```{r}
lm(outcome ~ exposure, data = sim3)
```

## *Tu turno 3*

### Usa `ntile()` de dplyr para calcular una versión binned de `confounder` llamada `confounder_q`. Crearemos una variable con 5 bins.
### Agrupa el dataset por la variable que acabas de crear y exposición
### Calcula la media del resultado para los grupos

`r countdown::countdown(minutes = 3)`

## *Tu turno 3*

```{r}
#| code-line-numbers: "|2|3-4"
#| output-location: fragment
sim3 |>
  mutate(confounder_q = ntile(confounder, 5)) |>
  group_by(confounder_q, exposure) |>
  summarise(avg_y = mean(outcome)) |>
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = exposure,
    values_from = avg_y,  
    names_prefix = "x_"
  ) |>
  summarise(estimate = x_1 - x_0) |
  summarise(estimate = mean(estimate))
```
